upgrade_rule: A newer upstream version requires its own complete semantic facts, exact runtime identity, differential evidence, and support decision before it becomes governed.

families.rationale: ECMAScript 2024 is an explicit compatibility target, not a latest-language alias; ECMAScript 2026 requires separate runtime and semantic certification.

10.42 and 10.43 intentionally bracket a material semantic change and remain compatibility targets; they are not deployment or patch-level security recommendations. Consumers must follow upstream lifecycle and backport guidance.

The 3.11 profiles are explicit minor-version compatibility targets and the upstream branch remains in security-fix support through October 2027; the exact 3.11.15 certification build is an empirical semantic anchor, not a Python distribution recommendation, and later minor versions require independent semantic certification.
